name: The Snow Girl
s: When a little girl goes missing during a parade in Málaga, a young newspaper journalist becomes fiercely determined to help Amaya's parents find her.

paragraphs.text: The Snow Girl () is a Spanish mystery thriller television series based on the novel by which stars Milena Smit.
